albums.title: 2nd International Post-COVID-19 Conference
albums.description: Economic Damages from Global Shocks: Building Resilience for the Future. Partners, policymakers, researchers and community leaders gathered at the Pearson Convention Centre in Brampton to examine how global shocks affect trade, finance and industry, and to explore practical paths toward recovery and long-term resilience.
